name: hue

description.en: open-source skill that learns any brand and turns it into a complete design system. works on claude code and codex. install once, every UI your assistant builds matches your brand.
description.zh: 开源技能，学习品牌并生成完整设计系统，适用于Claude Code和Codex。

install: git clone https://github.com/dominikmartn/hue（按 README 导入 Claude Code）

ecosystems.install: git clone https://github.com/dominikmartn/hue（按 README 导入 Claude Code）

audience.zh: 前端开发者和使用Claude Code构建UI的团队
audience.en: Frontend developers and teams building UI with Claude Code

usecases.zh: 让AI助手生成的界面自动匹配品牌设计系统
usecases.en: Make AI-generated interfaces automatically match brand design systems

author: dominikmartn
